description: acme/quarry's release feed, as GitHub serves releases.atom: v3.2.1 and v3.2.0 before the run, then v3.3.0-rc.1, a pre-release, is published and the trigger fires on it.
title: Release notes from quarry

items.title: Quarry 3.2.1
items.author: dana-q
items.content:
Fixes

  • quarry restore --jobs no longer hangs when a table has no rows (#831)

items.title: Quarry 3.2.0
items.author: dana-q
items.content: Quarry 3.2 makes restores of big databases fast and stops the restore error people hit most.

item.title: Quarry 3.3.0-rc.1
item.author: dana-q
item.content:
Release candidate for 3.3. Please try it and report what breaks.

What's new

  • quarry restore --resume picks up an interrupted restore where it stopped (#850)
  • quarry snapshot --compress zstd (#846)
